results.objective: Admin credentials must not be embedded in the browser bundle

results.expected: Secret absent from anything sent to the browser
results.actual: Admin password present in dev-server Login module: true. Fresh production build (vite build into a temp folder) contains the password: false; admin email: false. Existing client/dist: password false.
results.notes: Corrected after fresh-build check: Login.jsx only renders the quick-login block when import.meta.env.DEV, so Vite removes it (and the VITE_ADMIN_* values) from production bundles. results.objective: CORS must not trust arbitrary origins when credentials are enabled
results.steps: Request with Origin: https://evil.example; check Access-Control-Allow-Origin / -Credentials (server NODE_ENV=development)
results.actual: ACAO=https://evil.example; ACAC=true; preflight=204
results.notes: app.js allows every origin whenever NODE_ENV !== "production". With credentials:true this means any website could make authenticated calls if the server is ever run without NODE_ENV=production. SameSite=Lax limits cross-site cookie sending, which reduces but does not remove the risk.

results.steps: Login, copy cookie, POST /api/auth/logout, replay the old cookie on GET /api/auth/me

results.notes: Logout only clears the browser cookie; the JWT stays valid for its full 7 days (stateless, no server-side revocation or token version).

results.objective: Reset-token lifecycle: weak password rejected, invalid token rejected, one-time use, old password revoked
results.steps: Request reset for QA account; read token from private instance console; test weak pw, bogus token, valid reset, token re-use, old/new password login
results.expected: weak=400, bogus=400, valid=200, reuse=400, old pw=401, new pw=200
results.actual: weak=400, bogus=400, valid=200, reuse=400, oldPw=401, newPw=200
results.notes: Token is 32 random bytes, only its SHA-256 is stored, 1-hour expiry (code reviewed). Side note: the full reset URL is written to the server console (acceptable for dev, must be replaced by e-mail in production).
